description: Ayuntamiento de Donostia/San Sebastián: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Donostia/San Sebastián. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Donostia/San Sebastián. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Uso del euskera en las calles de Donostia; Aparcamientos disuasorios de Donostia / San Sebastián; Zonas de ordenación del aparcamiento (OTA) de Donostia / San Sebastián; Aparcamientos de superficie de Donostia / San Sebastián. Formats seen: X-ZIPPED-SHP, WMS, CSV, GEO%2BJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
